Exact finite counts; no population or performance inference. The m8 reference is conditioned historical data.

The reviewer replayed every one of 4,587,520 m16 descriptors with independently written EC, polynomial, source-lift,
interpolation, residual and canonical-identity code. All 128 status streams and branch commitments matched, including all
rejected descriptors.
All 164 accepted E1 equations, principal polynomial/divisor witnesses, E2 sums and transported encodings passed. The fixed
first4/last4/8 SHA-ranked sample is identified in math-verification.json; checking all rows is the explicitly wider scope. Every
projected matrix, affine/augmented rank, pivot span, right kernel, rank progress and source checkpoint passed.
Both m8 reference cells were validation-replayed for 458,752 descriptors. All old8 descriptors and canonical keys embed under
explicit fixture UID transport. There were zero historical accepted witnesses, so their empirical witness embedding is vacuous; a
separate p101 positive witness tested the nonvacuous prefix path and the opposite-source alias path.
All 19 known-false copies were rejected. They cover source a+1 and seeded-uniform alternatives, native lift,
U/anchor/pivot/kernel/affine/augmented rank, dropped/duplicated/changed statuses, missing/duplicated/reordered source
blocks, prefix, transported encoding and alias key. Four separate logical-content pointer mutations were rejected during custody
verification.
The 73 current native source/input bindings and all native receipt artifact hashes were rechecked. Three compressed
remote-object representations were read from an existing public local cache; the remaining compressed raw representation was
read from the repository. Stored SHA/size, gzip decoding and logical SHA/size matched, and 20 export file entries matched.
The reviewer made no fresh remote GET. Producer GET attestations and the parent-supplied publication custody are separate
from this local byte audit. Historical source/input maps are retained as receipt-bound metadata; excluded historical private
fixtures/helpers were not read or re-executed.
Counts and ranks describe exactly these two conditioned toy cases. There is no sampling uncertainty for this finite census,
while implementation and custody limits remain. Native primitive-operation vectors reconcile with their stage subtotals, but were
not independently instrumented. Pow internals, Python bookkeeping, general byte movement and a complete weighted S
remain excluded. Clocks are diagnostic and are not a performance comparison.
The native export honestly leaves producer runtime, model, session and role null. No missing provenance was copied from
planned metadata. No canonical scientific graph is changed: this exclusive-scope review adds its own evidence-linked chart,
and the native graph artifacts were content-hash checked.
Evidence files: math-verification.json, control-verification.json, reference-verification.json, custody-verification.json. Commands
and code are retained in review.py, phase2.py, controls_custody.py, render_review.py and the session transcript. The complete
read timeline is read-events.json.
